lead: A description list: label / value pairs laid out in columns, typically for the fields of a detail page. Every row is filled (an item that doesn't fit moves to the next row, and the last item in a row stretches over the columns left); in the horizontal layout each label and value has its own cell and the columns line up, like a table.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `descriptions.css`. The grid lines are the background showing through 1px gaps, so they stay right for cells spanning several columns.
styling.root: The root; `data-bordered` / `data-layout` / `data-size` / `data-column`, and `data-colon` when labels get a colon
styling.header: The title row, its title and the content on its right
styling.list: The `<dl>` and each item (`data-span` is the number of columns it spans)
